description: Baseline captured after Tranche AP. AP delivered: @ws kernel universality (PunctWsRegion + trailing-WS + ws-interleaved negated char class scan for CSS comments), payload f64 wiring fix (scan_json_number_f64 for JSON, scan_number_f64 for generic), structural dispatch redesign (synchronized peek-only, gated behind WS elision), SIMD WS bitmap construction, SIMD string scanner (scan_quoted_string_simd wired into production), NibbleLut DFA acceleration, SIMD delimiter scan, Tape::get_unchecked, CSS monolithic bench deletion, bootstrap enum fixes, gorgeous proc-macro fixes. CSS L4 tailwind.css parses successfully for the first time (was FAIL at offset 387594).
arch: Tape-first zero-copy parser with materialization tripartite (MustTape/TapeSpanOnly/TransparentElide). Payload enrichment: f64 via scan_json_number_f64 (JSON) / scan_number_f64 (generic). Structural dispatch infrastructure ready (synchronized peek-only, IR pass, ParserState helpers, alt.rs hybrid codegen) but gated behind structural_mode=false until inter-structural WS elision offsets pre-scan overhead. SIMD acceleration: u8x16 WS bitmap construction, escape-parity string scanning, NibbleLut DFA self-loop states, find_first_of_3 delimiter scan. @ws comment-aware kernel universal in CSS L4 (PunctWsRegion, trailing-WS, negated char class interleaving).

bbnf_workspace.notes: 2 pre-existing google_sheets_slab failures (parse_arithmetic, parse_let_nested) confirmed on master HEAD

json_citm.notes: +44.7% from SIMD WS bitmap + f64 payload + SIMD string scanner. Within 12% of sonic-rs (3097).

css_tailwind.notes: FIXED. Was parse failure at offset 387594. Now 534 MB/s with key dispatch.
